_doc: Which pet families can learn each tameable ability on WoW Forever. Two-source rule: an ability is listed for a family only when both sources agree. Trainer-only abilities (Growl, Great Stamina, Natural Armor, resistances) are learnable by every family and are not listed. Generated into Data/Families.lua by tools/build_data.py.
sources: https://foreverchanges.pro/hunter-pets (compares Forever 1.60.1.71037 client data with Classic; updated 2026-09-24)
Blizzard deep dive: every family can learn Bite or Claw (sometimes both) and Dash or Dive, plus one unique ability (https://worldofwarcraft.blizzard.com/news/24301515)
allFamiliesNote: Cower: Warcraft Tavern lists it for every family (ForeverChanges does not list it); beasts of Bat, Bird of Prey, Cat and Tallstrider families teach it and tames confirm it in game (Ornery / Fleeting Plainstrider), matching Classic where every family could learn Cower.
excluded: Bat: Bite (Warcraft Tavern only; ForeverChanges client data lists Bat with Dive and Sonic Blast only)
Core Hound: Lava Breath, Bite (Warcraft Tavern only; no tameable Core Hound in the data)
